extracted.name: Mezze Platter
extracted.description: Mezze are small plates and appetizers that are often shared before a meal in the Middle East. This mezze platter includes an assortment of these types of snacks, spreads, and dips, and it's perfect for entertaining. Find variations in the post above!

instruction_lines: Choose desired components from the list above and arrange on a large platter.
